title: USMTM Command Action Group Strategic Support Functions
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR COMBAT COMMAND > FA4885  HQ USMTM LGC
description: Establish a contractor-supported  non-personal services  capability to provide the Chief, USMTM with  decision advantage  and  predictable executive support  across (1) NCR/DoD/Interagency “atmospherics,” (2) security cooperation/FMS posture and engagement planning, (3) strategic communications, and (4) organizational effectiveness (OE) assessment and implementation support.
